an5.81:1.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca.
an5.81:1.3: Rajanīye rajjati, dusanīye dussati, mohanīye muyhati, kopanīye kuppati, madanīye majjati.
an5.81:1.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca. 3.
an5.81:2.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo ca.
an5.81:2.3: Rajanīye na rajjati, dusanīye na dussati, mohanīye na muyhati, kopanīye na kuppati, madanīye na majjati.
an5.81:2.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo cā
